message: No detected input validation: The code parses command-line arguments and loads data but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Model checkpoints are referenced by name (e.g., 'bert-base-multilingual-uncased') and loaded via HuggingFace without any checksum verification, pinned commits, or authentication checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the visible data preparation code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models via Hugging Face `transformers` (e.g., `load_model` with a checkpoint string like 'bert-base-multilingual-uncased') without any hash/signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled internal source check.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop performs standard forward/backward passes with gradient clipping but contains no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard AdamW/StepLR optimization with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-injection mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the evaluate function simply accumulates predictions and calls a single metrics_fn.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (evaluate function and data loaders) passes batch data directly to forward_fn without any shape, range, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (batch_hyp, loss) are consumed and accumulated without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model handles text inputs (NLP tasks), there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection anywhere in the code.
